name: 67578 · Stafford, KS
findings: ZIP 67578 (Stafford) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 67578 (Stafford) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
86% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
